sentence: This project studies how an anticancer vaccine could give long-term protection against cancer, with a focus on breast cancer.
This project studies how an enzyme that breaks down nutrients supports the brain as it becomes stressed in Alzheimer’s disease.
This project tries to find out whether low intensity ultrasound can protect hair follicle cells from the cell-killing effect of paclitaxel.
This project studies how separate auditory pathways in the brain come together in the cerebral cortex to form unified sound representations.
This project builds a way to measure how people with knee osteoarthritis walk and feel pain while walking, using sensors.
This project studies the structures of amyloid oligomers, which are linked to Alzheimer’s Disease.
This project builds a learning lab that tests decision support tools to improve diagnosis in a virtual clinical world.
This project develops radioligands for positron emission tomography imaging to study molecular targets involved in mental health disorders.
This project builds a technology to follow in real-time how telomere lengthening lets cancer cells divide in hard-to-treat pediatric cancers.
This project studies the antibody producing cells of lampreys to learn about evolutionary principles of the adaptive immune system.
This project develops methods to study how transplanted human neural populations integrate and function in the mouse brain.
This project builds clinical decision support tools that predict whether a patient will survive longer by accepting a donated lung offer or waiting.
This project tests whether natural language processing can automatically code the quality of exposure therapy for anxiety.
This project studies how the innate immune system and local inflammation might hinder olfactory cell regeneration and cause persistent smell loss after viral infections.
This project tries to find out how the sequence features of intrinsically disordered regions cause condensate formation and transcriptional repression in living cells.
This project looks for structural variation across the genome in people with blood cell traits, using whole genome sequencing.
This project uses computational techniques to study how lipids change the function of pentameric ligand-gated ion channels.
This project studies how dietary restriction changes DNA methylation and gene expression in intestinal stem cells as they age.
This project studies how gut microbes modify drugs and how interactions between gut bacteria determine microbiome composition.
This project studies extracellular vesicles as a way to track Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy and to deliver gene therapy.
